name: Azure Logic Apps
sku: Azure Logic Apps in its Consumption and Standard hosting models. The AI agentic workflows are not scored.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Designer-first workflows of actions with conditions, switches and inline code, for business processes across systems. It is aimed at integration and business automation more than data pipelines.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Every workflow starts with a trigger that fires when a condition is met, such as an email arriving or a new file appearing in a storage account.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Many triggers include scheduling capabilities that control how often the workflow runs.

orchestrate.ci-cd.note: Workflows can be created as Azure Resource Manager templates so deployments are automated across multiple environments and regions.

presentation.tagline: Low-code workflows that connect cloud and on-premises systems through 1,400+ connectors.
